title: Slient aim OpenSource
script:
local r = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local p = game:GetService("Players")
local u = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local s = game:GetService("RunService")
local l = p.LocalPlayer
local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
local t = nil
s.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local n = nil
local m = math.huge
local loc = u:GetMouseLocation()
for _, pl in ipairs(p:GetPlayers()) do
if pl ~= l and pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and pl.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
local h = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if h then
local pos, vis = c:WorldToViewportPoint(h.Position)
if vis then
local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - loc).Magnitude
if d < m and d < 150 then
m = d
n = pl
end
end
end
end
end
t = n
end)
local bh = require(r:WaitForChild("ModuleScripts"):WaitForChild("GunModules"):WaitForChild("BulletHandler"))
local old = bh.Fire
bh.Fire = function(args)
if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
args.Direction = (t.Character.Head.Position - args.Origin).Unit
end
return old(args)
end
local ch = require(r:WaitForChild("ModuleScripts"):WaitForChild("GunModules"):WaitForChild("GunFramework"):WaitForChild("CameraHandler"))
ch.accelerate = function() end
